hypotheses.latent_object: F(z)=f(z), the underlying univariate function with derivative df
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is recovered by applying its operator to F(z)=f(z): A_i = O_i[F].
required_assumptions: f is sufficiently differentiable at x
x != y for the distinct-node divided difference G0001
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The expressions are instances of the divided-difference / Hermite divided-difference family for one underlying function f. G0001 is the first divided difference on distinct nodes x,y; G0002 is the derivative at x, obtained as the repeated-node limit of G0001; G0003 is the corresponding Hermite divided difference with repeated node x, built from df(x) and the first divided difference.
